Remember that a full turn has a measure of ${360}^{∘}.$

Therefore, the measure of $∠AOB$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{30}\times {360}^{∘} & = \\ \frac{1\times {360}^{∘}}{30} & = \\ \frac{{360}^{∘}}{30} & .\end{aligned}
$$

It's common to write the fraction in parentheses and place the degree symbol outside, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{360}{30})}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
